item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00347","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C04","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.88,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: both are short Kennedy communications issued during the same economic downturn, link housing activity to unemployment relief, state that the President has directed the Housing and Home Finance Agency to eliminate delay or make previously approved assistance available promptly, and call for complementary local action. C04 is also a strong structural antecedent because it directs the same agency to accelerate housing construction and ensure federal assistance is available when required, but its longer programmatic format is less immediately similar. C15 shares the downturn framing and appeal for state or local action but lacks the specific housing-agency machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have today directed the Federal Housing and Home Finance Agency that the loan previously approved for you to build new public housing facilities be made available promptly","parent_excerpt":"I have directed the Housing and Home Finance Agency officials in Washington and in regional offices to eliminate all delay and to cooperate with local authorities in beginning construction of these projects at the earliest possible time","explanation":"Both use nearly parallel presidential-direction language to require the same federal housing agency to expedite already approved local housing activity."},{"child_excerpt":"In the midst of the present economic downturn and widespread unemployment","parent_excerpt":"Our efforts to improve the employment situation can be helped considerably by increased urban renewal activity","explanation":"Both situate expedited housing action as a response to unemployment and weak economic conditions."},{"child_excerpt":"I hope that diligent efforts will be made in every community in the nation","parent_excerpt":"I urge you to do everything within your ability to eliminate delay and I promise you the full cooperation of the Federal Government","explanation":"Both pair federal acceleration with an appeal for energetic action by local authorities."}]}
